### God’s Sovereignty Over Leviathan and Behemoth
Author: Christopher Ash
Site: The Gospel Coalition
URL: https://www.thegospelcoalition.org/article/gods-sovereignty-behemoth-leviathan/
Passage: Job 41:1-34
Points:
- Leviathan portrays undiluted supernatural evil and the terrifying adversary humanity cannot confront.
- Humans are completely helpless to tame, bargain with, or overcome this mighty ruler of pride.
- As a creature made by God, Leviathan remains held firmly on the Lord's leash.
- Believers facing suffering find comfort knowing that evil cannot exceed God's sovereign boundaries.
- Christ achieved ultimate victory over this ancient monster through His redemptive suffering on the cross.

### Bible Pathway - June 25, 2011
Author: Bible Pathway
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/biblepathways/bible-pathway-june-25-2011.html
Passage: Job 41:1-22
Points:
- God highlights the power of Leviathan to expose human helplessness before the Creator.
- Righteous sufferers are called to live by faith rather than demanding every explanation.
- Job's journey moves from asking why he suffers to trusting the One in control.
- Beholding God's unsearchable majesty humbles human self-righteousness into true repentance.
- Recognizing the Lord's supreme authority dispels fears and frustrations in the midst of trials.
